label: Detail edit preview

label: Edited emblem index
summary: The number of the emblem instance currently open in the detail editor.
details: The game compares it with 0: a value below 0 shows one set of widgets and 0 or more shows another, so a negative number most likely means that no emblem is being edited. That reading rests on those comparisons.

label: Detail X position
summary: The horizontal position of the emblem in the detail editor, as a decimal number.
details: Going by its name and its use, the game feeds it into the value of an editing control in the coat of arms designer.

label: Detail Y position
summary: The vertical position of the emblem in the detail editor, as a decimal number.
details: Going by its name and its use, the game feeds it into the value of an editing control in the coat of arms designer.

label: Detail rotation

details: The game converts it to a decimal number before putting it into a control's value. The unit (degrees) is not stated in the input.

label: Detail X scale
summary: The horizontal size factor of the emblem in the detail editor, as a decimal number.
details: Going by its name and its two uses, the game feeds it into the value of editing controls in the coat of arms designer.

label: Detail Y scale
summary: The vertical size factor of the emblem in the detail editor, as a decimal number.
details: Going by its name and its use, the game feeds it into the value of an editing control in the coat of arms designer.

label: Emblem textures

label: Max colors of selection

details: The game shows a widget only when this is greater than 0. Going by its name, the number belongs to the selected emblem; the input says no more.

label: Selected category index

details: The game uses it as the selected index of a list in the designer. Why it has two parts is not stated in the input.

label: Is color slot used

label: Is color selected

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a whole number; vanilla uses 1, 2 and 3

fields.name: Arg1

label: Finish color edit

fields.name: Arg0

label: Select color

fields.name: Arg0

summary: Sets a color slot of the emblem to the clicked palette color.

fields.name: Arg0

fields.values: a stat name in quotes (assumed from the name)

label: Terrain bonus
summary: The bonus or penalty the terrain gives this regiment type, as a whole number.
details: The combat window shows one widget when it is above 0 and another when it is below 0, outside the pursuit phase.

label: Is good aftermath
summary: Whether the aftermath counts as good for this regiment type, given whether its side is still fighting.
details: The combat window passes whether the side is still fighting and shows one widget for yes and another for no, during the pursuit phase. That 'good' means a favorable result is read from the name.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: Whether the side is still fighting.
fields.values: CombatSide.IsStillFighting

label: The regiment entry
summary: The men-at-arms entry of the combat window itself.
details: Going by its name and the same-named `Self` of other types, it hands the object over so it can be passed on. No game text uses it on this type.

label: The combat icon
summary: A game function of the map icons that gives access to the combat icon itself.
details: Going by its name, it is the access form of `Self`. No game text uses it on this type, and the game documents nothing more.

label: Icon combat
summary: The combat that this map icon shows.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of widgets in the map icon layer, so they can read the combat's own functions. Its return type is not registered.

label: Icon is selected
summary: Whether the combat icon is the selected one on the map.
details: Vanilla uses it as the visibility of a widget in the map icon layer.

label: Left is ally
summary: Whether the left side of the combat is an ally of the player.
details: Vanilla uses it as the visibility of a widget.

label: Left is enemy
summary: Whether the left side of the combat is an enemy of the player.
details: Vanilla shows the same widget when the left side is an enemy or is hostile (see LeftIsHostile).

label: Left is hostile
summary: Whether the left side of the combat is hostile to the player.
details: Vanilla shows the same widget when the left side is an enemy or is hostile. How hostile differs from enemy is not stated.

label: Left is neutral
summary: Whether the left side of the combat is neutral toward the player.
details: Vanilla checks it together with the right side: one widget shows when both are neutral, another when they are not both neutral.

label: Left is player
summary: Whether the left side of the combat is the player.
details: Vanilla uses it as the visibility of a widget in the map icon layer.

label: Icon click
summary: Handles a click on the combat icon on the map.
details: Vanilla fires it on the click of the icon. What it opens is not stated in the input.

label: Player leads left
summary: Whether the player commands the left side of the combat.
details: Going by its name, it is true when the player is the commander on the left. The game's texts do not use this name at all.

label: Player leads right
summary: Whether the player commands the right side of the combat.
details: Going by its name, it is true when the player is the commander on the right. The game's texts do not use this name at all.

label: Right is ally
summary: Whether the right side of the combat is an ally of the player.
details: Vanilla uses it as the visibility of a widget.

label: Right is enemy
summary: Whether the right side of the combat is an enemy of the player.
details: Vanilla shows the same widget when the right side is an enemy or is hostile (see RightIsHostile).

label: Right is hostile
summary: Whether the right side of the combat is hostile to the player.
details: Vanilla shows the same widget when the right side is an enemy or is hostile. How hostile differs from enemy is not stated.

label: Right is neutral
summary: Whether the right side of the combat is neutral toward the player.
details: Vanilla checks it together with the left side: one widget shows when both are neutral, another when they are not both neutral.

label: Right is player
summary: Whether the right side of the combat is the player.
details: Vanilla uses it as the visibility of a widget in the map icon layer.
